Hana: Heads up 12: our pulse shows launch-post MQLs down ~40% during the webinar spike window. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/launch-posts?range=72h

Jake: Noticed it. Quick check: lots of sessions with utm_campaign blank. Could be the reg flow losing params when redirecting from the webinar provider.

Priya: I pulled the registration rows for Mar 15-16. SQL:```
SELECT utm_campaign, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM registrations
WHERE created_at >= '2026-03-15' AND created_at < '2026-03-17'
GROUP BY utm_campaign
ORDER BY cnt DESC;
```
Result: big NULL bucket (~260 rows).

Matt (mktg-ops): FYI release 2026.03.14 changed redirect middleware. Might have dropped querystring on 302. I'll grab CDN logs.

Hana: Proposed immediate steps: 1) revert attribution precedence to prefer utm_campaign if present, 2) add referrer fallback for missing campaign, 3) reprocess last 72h of leads after fix. Any objections?

Jake: Agree. Also we should avoid touching SFDC imports live. @Matt can we pause lead imports for 30m during reprocess?

Matt (mktg-ops): Yes. I'll open a pause window with Sales, tag ops. ETA: 35min.

Priya: Frontend patch is tiny, I'll open PR. Snippet:```js
// prefer utm_campaign, else fallback to referrer parsing, then cookie
const campaign = url.searchParams.get('utm_campaign') || parseReferrer(document.referrer) || cookies.get('last_campaign');
```
I'll include tests for referrer parsing.
